item: Qualification integrity: attempt timestamps, a live curated stamp reads curated, and boot withdraws (never re-admits) inversions with an uncapped revert record (diagnostics rank 14, C52)
status: SHIPPED (unit-tested with fakes; field effect appears at each instance's next boot)
key_paths: src/catalog/qualification_integrity.py; src/backup/import_reports.py; src/catalog/qualification_export.py; src/discovery/source_trail.py; src/api/main.py; scripts/repair_qualification_inversions.py; tests/test_qualification_auto_repair.py; docs/ledger/OPEN_QUEUE.md
summary: qualification-integrity.json gains last_attempt_at, last_judging_attempt_at and the 24h attempt counts, plus every automatic repair (repaired_total, name, time, prior status). The export and the source provenance read a row whose LIVE stamp is oo-curated-catalog-1 as curated even with copied-in judging history (curated_stamp_with_judging_history counts them). At deferred boot, local DB only (airplane mode included), sources whose live verdict is the catalogue's own stamp (or nothing) and whose newest judging attempt says disqualified go back to disqualified; a verdict measured here is never changed by an imported history on its own (rule 12 = b: reported as left_for_local_recheck_total with each row's live_stamp, known limit recorded in OPEN_QUEUE until a forced re-check list exists), and the opposite direction stays operator-run. OO_QUALIFICATION_AUTO_REPAIR=0 (test conftest only) switches the boot repair off; the operator script honours the revert hold unless --ignore-hold. Every repair is kept with the status and stamp it replaced in app_state (one key per run plus an index, no cap, never merged on restore); scripts/repair_qualification_inversions.py --revert-repairs undoes them and holds the domain out of later repairs. RC06 note recorded in OPEN_QUEUE. Also: the import report counts a catalogue-stamped row that merely received the same measured qualified as confirmed (not as a newly qualified source) and reports rows holding only the catalogue stamp apart from verdicts reached or adopted here.
